title.zh: 汗证与过敏性疾病：汗先取心经、依部位与察经定病经；过敏病多取太阴经，尺泽、阴陵泉一对
title.en: Sweating and Allergic Disease: Sweat Starts with the Heart Channel and Is Placed by Site and Palpation; Allergy Mostly Takes Taiyin, the Chize-Yinlingquan Pair

summary.zh: 汗证他先想到手少阴心经，再按盗汗、自汗、绝汗、外感无汗分别选穴，并说出汗部位只是线索、须与察经结合。过敏性疾病他认为经络参与所有疾病并能调整之；本章7例中6例察出太阴经异常，皮肤病尤其常取尺泽、阴陵泉，呼吸道过敏则常配复溜；此外还记了列缺的取法。
summary.en: For sweating he thinks first of Hand Shaoyin, then chooses points separately for night sweat, spontaneous sweat, collapse sweat and external-type no-sweat, and says the site of sweating is only a clue to be joined to palpation. For allergic disease he holds that channels take part in every disease and can regulate it; in the chapter 6 of 7 cases showed Taiyin changes, skin cases often take Chize and Yinlingquan, respiratory allergy often adds Fuliu; he also records how to find Lieque.

takeaways.zh: 汗首先想到手少阴心经，再按类型选穴：血汗同源、心主血，所以汗的异常排出首先考虑手少阴。盗汗(睡中出汗醒后止)为心肾不交，取阴郄配复溜(案38解读称阴郄能活血补心气、复溜为肾经母穴滋肾水调汗液)；自汗(醒时或急躁、热饮、运动则汗)为营卫不和、卫表不固，太阳经与督脉主“开”，故取阴郄配后溪；按气虚所在再加本脏原穴，阳虚自汗加大椎固表并可灸；大汗淋漓的绝汗(脱汗)灸神阙、气海。
takeaways.en: Sweat first suggests Hand Shaoyin: blood and sweat share a source and the Heart governs blood, so abnormal sweating first calls for Hand Shaoyin. Night sweat (sweating in sleep, stopping on waking) is Heart-Kidney disharmony: Yinxi with Fuliu (Case 38 comment: Yinxi moves blood and supplements Heart qi, Fuliu is the Kidney mother point that nourishes Kidney water and regulates sweat). Spontaneous sweat (on waking, agitation, hot drink or exertion) is disharmony of ying and wei with an unsecured surface; Taiyang and Du govern "opening", so Yinxi with Houxi. Add the yuan-source point of the deficient organ; in yang-deficient sweat add Dazhui to secure the surface, moxa allowed; profuse "collapse" sweat calls for moxa on Shenque and Qihai.

takeaways.zh: 出汗部位提示病经，但最后以察经为准：足心汗多为足少阴与足太阳，手心汗属手厥阴郁热熏蒸，背部汗多属太阳经；他随即说要把汗的性质、部位和其他症状与经络诊察结合，才能判断哪条经或哪个脏腑异常。案42的手足心汗如洗，察出的是少阴经异常(神门、水泉有脆络)，他即取少阴经，而不是套用“手心汗属手厥阴”。
takeaways.en: The site of sweating hints at the channel, but palpation has the last word: sweat of the soles is usually Foot Shaoyin with Foot Taiyang, of the palms Hand Jueyin stifling heat, of the back mostly Taiyang. He then says the character, site and other symptoms must be joined to channel palpation to decide which channel or organ is abnormal. In Case 42 (palms and soles sweating as if washed) palpation found Shaoyin (brittle vessels at Shenmen and Shuiquan), and he treated Shaoyin rather than applying "palm sweat = Hand Jueyin".

takeaways.zh: 阳虚的手足心汗，取少阴原穴并在神门加灸：案42认为手足心大量出汗是阳气不足的自汗，阳气主要由心肾所主，故取手足少阴原穴神门、太溪，神门加灸15分钟温补心肾阳气；针感传至手指脚趾，灸完手心转暖、汗出随即停止(1诊，显效)。这与盗汗取阴郄、复溜的滋阴思路不同，区别在于虚在阳还是阴。
takeaways.en: For yang-deficient palm and sole sweat he takes the Shaoyin yuan points and adds moxa at Shenmen. Case 42 reads profuse palm-sole sweat as spontaneous sweat from insufficient yang, which is chiefly governed by Heart and Kidney, so Shenmen and Taixi (yuan points of Hand and Foot Shaoyin), with 15 minutes of moxa on Shenmen to warm Heart and Kidney yang; needle sensation reached fingers and toes, the palms warmed after moxa and sweat stopped at once (1 visit, marked effect). This differs from the yin-nourishing Yinxi-Fuliu used for night sweat: the difference is yang versus yin deficiency.

takeaways.zh: 外感发热无汗，用太阴经穴帮助太阳宣发：《伤寒论》所谓太阳实证汗不出，他取经渠、大都，再加手阳明原穴合谷；合谷加大椎也能解表。案40的自汗则从相反方向用同一思路：太阴主开，肺卫不固，取经渠宣肺、太白与手足三里温补脾胃，大椎上的崇骨反应明显，点刺加灸15分钟，3次汗症临床痊愈。
takeaways.en: For external fever without sweat he uses Taiyin points to help Taiyang disperse wei qi: in what the Shanghan Lun calls Taiyang excess with no sweating, Jingqu and Dadu plus the Hand Yangming yuan point Hegu; Hegu with Dazhui also releases the exterior. Case 40 (spontaneous sweat) uses the same channel logic from the other side: Taiyin governs opening, Lung wei is unsecured, so Jingqu to disperse the Lung, Taibai with Hand and Foot Zusanli to warm Spleen and Stomach, Chonggu (reactive above Dazhui) pricked and moxaed 15 minutes; sweat cured clinically in 3 visits.

takeaways.zh: 过敏性病是经络能调整的：他把过敏性鼻炎、哮喘、过敏性结肠炎、荨麻疹算作四个主要的变态反应病，视为对刺激反应过激；引《内经》“经脉者，决死生，处百病，调虚实”，说所有疾病皆有经络参与，经络对所有疾病有调整作用，此作用很强，甚至有时超过药物。皮肤、气管过敏常与食物过敏并列，是因肺与大肠相表里。
takeaways.en: He holds allergic disease to be adjustable through the channels: allergic rhinitis, asthma, allergic colitis and urticaria are the four main allergic diseases, an over-reaction to a stimulus. Quoting the Neijing line that the channels "determine life and death, handle the hundred diseases, regulate deficiency and excess", he says every disease involves the channels and the channels can regulate every disease, sometimes more strongly than drugs. Skin or airway allergy is paired with food allergy because the Lung and Large Intestine are exterior-interior.

takeaways.zh: 过敏性皮肤病多是太阴经异常，取尺泽、阴陵泉一对：案46～49的荨麻疹或干裂脱屑性皮疹都察出太阴经异常，都取尺泽加阴陵泉(手足太阴合穴，调气机、化湿，肺主皮毛)，再依证配曲池、血海、大椎、足三里等；他说案46是“典型”运用，20年荨麻疹回顾病例也取此对穴，8次痊愈。但皮肤科诊后絮语同时提醒：不要以为一切皮肤病都取太阴经，仍须察经再选经。
takeaways.en: Allergic skin disease is mostly Taiyin, and he takes the Chize-Yinlingquan pair. Cases 46-49 (urticaria or dry, scaling rash) all showed Taiyin changes and all took Chize plus Yinlingquan (he-sea points of Hand and Foot Taiyin, regulating qi movement and resolving damp, the Lung governing skin and hair), adding Quchi, Xuehai, Dazhui, Zusanli and so on by pattern. He calls Case 46 a "typical" use, and the 20-year urticaria review case also used this pair, cured in 8 visits. The skin chapter essay adds a limit: not every skin disease takes Taiyin; palpate first.

takeaways.zh: 呼吸道过敏是肺肾一线：案43(过敏性哮喘，14诊后一年未发)以尺泽、太渊、列缺、足三里、点刺大椎为主，四诊起加复溜，他解释肺为肾之母、尺泽与复溜为母子经相应穴，有“金水相生”作用，故常取尺泽、复溜治疗过敏性疾病；案44过敏性鼻炎则说大部分属肺肾两虚，常取尺泽配复溜，晨起发作属阳虚卫气不固，另用督脉穴和灸。
takeaways.en: In respiratory allergy he works the Lung-Kidney line. Case 43 (allergic asthma, no relapse a year after 14 visits) used Chize, Taiyuan, Lieque, Zusanli and pricked Dazhui, adding Fuliu from the fourth visit; he explains that the Lung is mother of the Kidney, Chize and Fuliu are mother-child corresponding points with a "metal-water generating" action, so Chize with Fuliu is often taken for allergic disease. In Case 44 (allergic rhinitis) he says most such cases are Lung-Kidney deficiency and often take Chize with Fuliu; morning onset was read as yang deficiency with unsecured wei qi, so Du points and moxa were added.

takeaways.zh: 两个操作点：一是针后可能先加重，荨麻疹回顾案中针后当日皮疹骤成片，他称之为“疾病反应”，并嘱不要再服抗过敏药，3次后不再发；二是列缺要取在手太阴经的缝隙：他认为“以手交叉取食指尽处”应理解为两手掌相贴，从太渊沿手太阴经往肘推，用心循摸到骨上凹陷点即列缺，取在手阳明经上则未起到应有疗效。案45还说明皮肤病也可用灸：阳池、中泉悬灸，3诊痊愈。
takeaways.en: Two operating points. First, the reaction after needling may worsen first: in the urticaria review case the rash came out in sheets on the day of needling, which he calls a "disease reaction", and he told the patient not to take antihistamines again; it did not recur after 3 visits. Second, Lieque must be found in the gap of the Hand Taiyin channel: he reads "the tip of the index finger with hands crossed" as the two palms pressed together, pushing from Taiyuan along Hand Taiyin toward the elbow and feeling with the mind for the bony hollow; taken on the Hand Yangming channel it gave no proper effect. Case 45 also shows that moxa can be used on skin disease: suspended moxa at Yangchi and Zhongquan, cured in 3 visits.

how_to_use.zh: 汗证：先想手少阴，分盗汗、自汗、绝汗、外感无汗(表1)，再用部位作线索并以察经为准(表2的五例)。过敏病：先察经，多见太阴则用尺泽、阴陵泉，呼吸道过敏多考虑加复溜；取列缺按他的推法找骨上凹陷(表3)。
how_to_use.en: Sweating: think Hand Shaoyin first, separate night sweat, spontaneous sweat, collapse sweat and external no-sweat (Table 1), use site as a clue and let palpation decide (five cases in Table 2). Allergy: palpate first; where Taiyin shows, use Chize and Yinlingquan, and consider adding Fuliu in respiratory allergy; find Lieque by his pushing method to the bony hollow (Table 3).

caveats.zh: 原文OCR：阴郄多误作“阴”“阴部”“阴都”，此处按案38解读“心经的郄穴”读作阴郄；案46“天稚”应指大椎(解读称在大椎刺血拔罐)；“尊麻疹”即荨麻疹。汗的分类是他的“讨论”式经验总结，不是固定处方；案41头汗有多经异常，首诊只取少阴三穴，后续另加穴。
caveats.en: OCR: Yinxi is often misprinted as 阴, 阴部 or 阴都; it is read here as Yinxi from the Case 38 comment ("the xi-cleft point of the Heart channel"). "天稚" in Case 46 should be Dazhui (the comment says bleeding and cupping at Dazhui); "尊麻疹" is urticaria. The sweat typology is his discussion-style experience, not a fixed prescription; Case 41 had many abnormal channels, and the first visit used only three Shaoyin points, others being added later.
